newsitem.title: UK: First Woolwich shr auction at 315.35p/shr.
newsitem.headline: First Woolwich shr auction at 315.35p/shr.

text.p: British building society-turned bank Woolwich Plc said on Tuesday it had offered 92.55 million shares in the first share auction on Monday and they were sold at an average price of 315.35 pence.
Woolwich made its debut on the London Stock Exchange on Monday at 368 pence before closing at 334p.
Woolwich said the lowest bid price was 305 pence while the highest was 345p.
Another 92.55 million shares representing 5.8 percent of the company's issued share capital would be offered for sale in the second auction today, it said.
